text: This case adds xs-c++’s filtering rules, relative-path handling, and files-from input to xs-rs, filling in three missing capabilities rather than tuning speed directly. It matters because xs-rs needs those options to handle the same kinds of transfers as xs-c++ before it can claim feature parity. The scoreboard’s only completed noop comparison, on congress-sample, still shows xs-rs taking 1.741 times as long as xs-c++, while the real-projects noop result is pending.
